__comment: Per-season weighted weather table. Loaded by the WeatherManager autoload.
On each scheduled switch (a daily alarm), the manager draws the next day's weather from the
current season's weighted set. Draws use a SEEDED rng stream derived from world_seed + calendar
position, so a given seed replays identical weather (parallels the determinism Hard Rule).
Each season maps to an array of { weather, weight } entries. 'weather' must match an id in a
data/weather/*.json file. Higher weight = more likely. Weights are relative, not percentages.
Stonehearth keeps this table in its season/biome data; Deepdraft has no seasons data file yet,
so the schedule lives here. Values below are a starting distribution and are TBD in a tuning pass.
Keys beginning with '__' are documentation comments and are skipped by the loader.
